submission.justification: S1 is excluded because its validation-region disagreement (35%) is far above the 10% tolerance, so its background estimate is not robust. S3 (6%) and S2 (3%) both pass. S3 gives a higher significance than S2 at every working point I scanned (30, 50 and 70% efficiency). Both peak near 50%, where S3 gives 3.32 sigma and S2 gives 2.74 sigma. I did not scan between the points, so the optimum could sit slightly away from 50%. The significances are statistical-only.

requirements.evidence: Among the robust options, S3 at 50% efficiency gives 3.32 sigma. S2 gives at most 2.74 sigma. Only 30, 50 and 70% were scanned.
S3 validation-region disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance. S1 (35%) was rejected.
